apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway

  name: app-gateway
  namespace: default
spec:
  gatewayClassName: traefik
  listeners:
    - name: http
      protocol: HTTP
      port: 8000
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute

  name: app-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  hostNames:
    - app.example.com
  rules:
  - matches:

        type: PathPrefix
        value: /app
    backend:
      service:
        name: app
        port:
          number: 80
EOF"}
